description.en: A small single-trunk plant has a crown of fronds with unequal pinnule rows and associated cones.
description.zh: 小型单干植物具含不等小叶列的叶冠及相伴孢子叶穗。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Paratingia wudensis; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Paratingia wudensis 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Four-ranked unequal pinnules and a combined frond-cone crown differ from the two-row Noeggerathia specimen.
distinctness.zh: 四列不等小叶及叶穗同冠区别于两列Noeggerathia标本。

modeling_brief.en: Design a narrow trunk and asymmetric paired leaflet sizes; use the ash-buried crown as the layout reference.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立窄干及不等大小成对小叶，以火山灰埋藏叶冠为布局依据。

uncertainty: Flattening affects apparent crown positions; this is a spore plant, not a cycad.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: A new whole-plant species of Paratingia from the early Permian
sources.supports: Paratingia wudensis crown of fronds and cones, differently sized pinnule rows.
